advances: Exact fixed-body buffered cap minimization at one invariant positive buffer with global deepestness. The resulting normalized depth is above 2/9.
author: PK-research-agent
proof:
Both positive arrays have nonincreasing successive differences, so their interpolants are positive concave. Their box inequalities define a full-dimensional compact convex body. The sampled fibers are the five stated rectangles. Their areas are $V_z=2r_zH_z$, and each is less than $M/2$. Any proper nonempty closed minor is a consecutive chain. A singleton occupies one parity, and a chain with at least two sites occupies both parities and has mass less than $M$ because the omitted fibers are positive. This proves the quotas. The centered rectangle covariance is diagonal with entries $r_z^2/12,H_z^2/3$. Averaging with weights $V_z/M$ gives positive $\Sigma_{xx},\Sigma_{yy}$ and $\Sigma_{xy}=0$.

At $X=0$ in the middle fiber, Jensen's inequality for the convex function $b\mapsto b^{-3}$ gives $E_{K_0}(0)=V_0$ because the mean denominator is one, and the constant denominator attains it. Put $c=\Sigma_{xx}/\Sigma_{yy}$. In continuous normal coordinates $(t,u)$, the minimal buffered margin at the origin is $az+tx+uy+\delta\sqrt{ct^2+u^2}$. Reflection in the two continuous coordinates allows $t,u\ge0$ and leaves $a$ free. Replace the displacement by the smaller $\delta u$ to obtain a contained comparison cap. This is equality for $t=0$. The two claimed halfspaces have equal mass by reflection, with exact value
$$
Q=2r_{-2}H_{-2}+\sum_{z=-1}^{1}r_z(H_z-z/2+\delta)=8130713/1600000.
$$

For $t,u>0$ write $a=sb$ with $s\in\{-1,1\}$ and $b\ge0$, and normalize $t+u+b=1$. For each sampled $z$ and each $\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2\in\{-1,1\}$ put
$$
\ell_{z,\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2}(t,u,b)=\epsilon_1 r_z t/2+(\epsilon_2 H_z+\delta)u+szb.
$$
Integration over the rectangle, using the second antiderivative $x_+^2/2$ of the half-line indicator, gives its comparison cap area as $(2tu)^{-1}\sum_{\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2}\epsilon_1\epsilon_2(\ell_{z,\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2})_+^2$. Thus $2tu$ times the total comparison area minus $Q$ times $2tu$ is the piecewise quadratic
$$
P_s=\sum_{z,\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2}\epsilon_1\epsilon_2(\ell_{z,\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2})_+^2-2tuQ .
$$
The following exact finite calculation checks its sign. Start with the closed normal simplex with vertices $e_1,e_2,e_3$ and the matrix $A$ with $A_{12}=A_{21}=-Q$ and all other entries zero. For $z$ in increasing order use its four forms with sign pairs $(+,+),(-,+),(+,-),(-,-)$ in that order. Replace each convex polygon by its two closed clips against $\ell\ge0$ and $\ell\le0$. Keep vertices on the required side, and for endpoints $v,w$ of an edge with strictly opposite signs include $(\ell(w)v-\ell(v)w)/(\ell(w)-\ell(v))$. Delete consecutive duplicate vertices and zero-area pieces. On each positive clip add $\epsilon_1\epsilon_2 ll^{\mathsf T}$ to its matrix, where $l$ is the coefficient vector of $\ell$; keep the previous matrix on the negative clip. The nondegenerate fan triangles from the first vertex of each final polygon cover the simplex with disjoint interiors because each clipping step partitions a convex polygon into the two indicated sides. The quadratic equals $v^{\mathsf T}Av$ on each resulting triangle, including seams where the corresponding linear forms vanish.

For triangle vertices $v_0,v_1,v_2$, compute $\beta_{ij}=v_i^{\mathsf T}Av_j$ for $0\le i\le j\le2$. The [rational triangle certificate](../assets/pk-nov6/computations/globally_deepest_rectangle_inside_facets_certificate_two_sided.json) records 54 polygons and 94 triangles for $s=-1$, and 56 polygons and 99 triangles for $s=1$. All 1,158 coefficients are nonnegative. For each triangle and every nonempty subset $I$ of its vertex indices, vanishing of all $\beta_{ij}$ on $I$ implies that all those vertices have $t=0$ or all have $u=0$. These finite rational comparisons are reproduced from the displayed inputs by the [clipping verifier](../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_globally_deepest_rectangle_inside_facets_two_sided.py). An [independent reconstruction check](../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_global_rectangle_inside_certificate_audit_slab_recovery.py) also tests the triangle containment, separation of their interiors, area sum, corner signs, and coefficients directly. At a point with barycentric coordinates $\gamma_i$ the quadratic equals $\sum_i\beta_{ii}\gamma_i^2+2\sum_{i<j}\beta_{ij}\gamma_i\gamma_j$. A zero would therefore have positive barycentric support inside one of the tested coordinate axes. This proves $P_s>0$ whenever $t,u>0$, so the actual cap there costs strictly more than $Q$.

On the vertical-normal axis $t=0,u=1$ the exact mass is $F_v(a)=\sum_zr_z\operatorname{clamp}(H_z+az+\delta,0,2H_z)$, where $\operatorname{clamp}(x,0,V)=\max(0,\min(x,V))$. Its breakpoint list, including zero, is $-8089/8000,-8031/8000,-1/2,0,1999/4000,2001/4000,8027/8000,8093/8000$. Substitution gives masses in units of $1/1600000$ of $8146576,8134744,8130713,8142713,8154707,8153103,8149078,8135614$. It is affine between consecutive breakpoints and constant on both unbounded tails since every off-base fiber is saturated there. Thus its unique minimum is at $a=-1/2$. On the horizontal-normal axis $t=1,u=0$, use the lower cap with zero buffer. Its mass is $F_h(a)=\sum_z2H_z\operatorname{clamp}(r_z/2+az,0,r_z)$. Its breakpoints with zero are $-51/100,-203/400,-101/400,-1/4,0,1/4,101/400,203/400,51/100$, with masses in the same units of $8146168,8138077,8131753,8147687,8140687,8133687,8149621,8143297,8135206$. Affinity and the constant tails give minimum $Q+13/20000$. A purely base cap through zero has one of the two closed masses $\sum_{z\le0}V_z$ and $\sum_{z\ge0}V_z$, both above $Q$. These cases and reflection exhaust all ambient normals. Strictly relaxing either minimizing threshold adds positive area at its proper middle cut. Hence the two displayed halfspaces are the complete critical menu.

At bases $-2,-1,1,2$, the respective outward closed pure-base caps have masses $4001/2000,812741/200000,3245483/800000,403899/200000$, all below $Q$, independently of the continuous mark. In the middle fiber the constant denominator gives $E_{K_0}(X)\le V_0$. For $X\ne0$ the derivative of the integral at the constant denominator in parameter direction $-X$ is $-3V_0|X|^2<0$ by the zero centroid. Small parameter changes are admissible on the compact rectangle, even at a boundary mark, so the inequality is strict. The vertical displacement $\delta_X=\varepsilon\sqrt{\Sigma_{yy}}(E_{K_0}(X)/M)^{1/3}$ is therefore at most $\delta$, strictly less at $X\ne0$. The vertical cap with sign agreeing with the second coordinate $y_0$ of $X$ has threshold $|y_0|-\delta_X>-\delta$ at $X\ne0$ with base tilt $-1/2$. It is contained in the corresponding cap of mass $Q$ and loses a positive own strip because the old own cut was proper. This proves unique global deepestness. Finally the upper-sign cap has trace boundary $y=-H_{-2}$ at $-2$ and $y=H_2$ at $2$, so captures the former fiber wholly and only the top facet on the latter fiber. Reflection in $y$ gives the other sign. The three remaining cuts meet the respective interiors.
statement:
Let $C\subset\mathbb R^{1+2}$ over $[-2,2]$ have rectangular fibers $[-r(z)/2,r(z)/2]\times[-H(z),H(z)]$ with piecewise-affine widths and halfheights. At $z=-2,-1,0,1,2$ their values are
$$
r=(1,51/50,51/50,203/200,101/100),\qquad
H=(4001/4000,8091/8000,403/400,8029/8000,3999/4000).
$$
This is an actual convex body with precisely these five integer fibers, total mixed area $M=8140687/800000$ and strict proper closed-minor count quotas: every proper nonempty consecutive chain of bases has mass less than its number of occupied parities times $M/2$.

For a mark $(p,X)$ in a sampled fiber define $E_{K_p}(X)=\inf_a\int_{K_p}[1+a\cdot(w-X)]^{-3}\,dw$ over denominators positive on the fiber. Let $\Sigma$ be the area-weighted within-fiber covariance, and use closed buffered caps with minimal margin at $(p,X)$ given by
$$
a(z-p)+v\cdot(w-X)+\varepsilon\,(E_{K_p}(X)/M)^{1/3}\sqrt{v^{\mathsf T}\Sigma v},
$$
with nonzero ambient normal $(a,v)$ and with the nonnegative side captured. The raw buffered depth is the infimum of original mixed areas over these caps, allowing further outward threshold relaxations. Put $\delta=1/4000$, $V_0=20553/10000$ and $\varepsilon=\delta/[\sqrt{\Sigma_{yy}}(V_0/M)^{1/3}]$.

The unique global deepest sampled mark is $(0,0,0)$, of raw depth $Q=8130713/1600000$ and normalized depth $8130713/16281374$. Its only minimizing closed buffered halfspaces are $\pm y-z/2\ge-\delta$. In each, the base $-2$ fiber is wholly captured with a length-one inside supporting facet, the base $2$ fiber has an outside supporting facet of length $101/100$, and the other three traces are proper.
title: Every critical cap at a unique deepest buffered rectangle mark has an inside facet
